title: 5 Things In Space Terrifying Enough To Keep You Up At Night

scenes.voiceover: Space looks calm and empty. It is neither. It is full of things extreme enough to erase us in an instant.
scenes.visualConcept: An astronomer realizes something is wrong (reused Higgsfield clip).

scenes.voiceover: Rogue planets. Entire worlds torn from their stars, drifting through the dark with no sun, invisible until they are already here.
scenes.visualConcept: Icy rogue world drifting (reused Veo clip).

scenes.voiceover: Stars so colossal that our entire Sun beside them is a single, invisible grain of sand.
And when the largest of them die, they detonate in an instant, shining brighter than an entire galaxy.
And you are not safe from any of it. Right now, you are being hurled through the universe at over two million kilometers an hour.
scenes.visualConcept: Galaxy racing through the cosmos (reused Higgsfield clip).

scenes.voiceover: And one day, the Sun will fade, and everything you have ever known will drift silently into the endless cold.
scenes.visualConcept: Lone figure on a frozen world under a looming planet (reused Higgsfield clip).
